curious: [L. curiosus, from cura, care. See Cure.]

hew: preterit tense hewed; participle passive hewed or hewn.

preterit tense hewed; participle passive hewed or hewn. [Sax. heawian; G. hauen; D. houwen; Sw. hugga; Dan. hugger. In Sw. hugg is a cut, a slash; Dan. hug, a beating, a striking; so that the primary sense is to strike, to drive with the hand. See Hoe.]
provision: [Fr. from L. provisio, provideo. See Provide.]
suppose: [Fr. supposer; L. suppositus, suppono; It. supporre; Sp. suponer; sub and pono, to put.]
warn: [Sax. warnian; Sw. varna; G. warnen; formed on the root of ware, wary. Sax. warian. This is our garnish, as used in law, Norm. garnisher; also garner, for guarner, to warn, to admonish or give notice.]
